description: The agents: each with its role, title, state and whether it is on. `agent_mode` says which kind of workspace this is: "team" (an agent per role: CEO, engineer, Creative Director…) or "one" (one assistant, named in `assistant`, that does every kind of work, with the company's own agents beside it). Chat with one through ask_agent.
